title: Binary expansion length from a bounded representation
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers and let $w$ be a finite bit string whose value is at least $n$ and whose length is at most $m$. Then the length of the binary expansion of $n$ is at most $m$.

the length of $w$ is at most $m$
